desktop.notes:
• Culling dashboard, redone: the 📊 button in the top bar. Four big numbers - time spent, pace (seconds per photo), photos sorted and keep rate - then the funnel and keep / discard / undecided now; the rest in one small line. Closes with ✕, Esc or a click outside.
• Session log: sort by any column (▲ ▼), scrolls; click a session to see everything recorded under it and rename it there. Pace shows ▲ faster / ▼ slower than the session before. The log is also kept as culling-log.json with your data backups.
• Top bar: ▶ Slideshow and 📊 Dashboard as icons (names on hover); Backup has a card → drive icon. Tools and Settings are one shorter menu, in groups.
• Slideshow: mouse wheel or ← → = previous / next photo, ↓ = show it in Explorer. Anything else stops it, as before.
• Send to Curish no longer copies the photo: it stays where it is; only its data goes into the Library (a link), so Curish edits the original non-destructively.
